create_registry_instance: create a Registry instance to store and manage registered functions or classes as a dictionary
register_function_or_class: register a function or class into the Registry using the register decorator method
register_with_custom_name: register an object with a custom name using the register_name method to avoid collisions
register_with_metadata: register a function with additional metadata using the register_with_info decorator
unregister_and_retrieve_info: unregister a named object from the Registry and retrieve its stored metadata with get_info
